figures.caption: Figure 1 ( a ) GPCs of Pt /uniFB01 lms according to the exposure time of the precursor and counter reactants during the ALD process. HDMP and O2 gas were used as the precursor and counter reactant, respectively, for the ALD of Pt. ( b ) Apparent coverage of the Pt /uniFB01 lms deposited by ALD using the MeCpPtMe3 (blue) and HDMP (red) precursors. The solid lines indicate the corresponding /uniFB01 tting results for the nucleation model. ( c -f ) Typical SEM images showing the Pt deposited via ALD using the MeCpPtMe3 precursor ( c , d ) and the HDMP precursor ( e , f ) at 100 and 200 cycles. ( g ) Density functional theory-calculated energies of the critical points along the reaction coordinate for the adsorption of the two precursors. ( h ) Electrical resistivity of the Pt /uniFB01 lms deposited by ALD according to the number of ALD cycles.

Figure 2 ( a -b ) GPCs ( a ) and electrical resistivity ( b ) of the Pt /uniFB01 lms according to the growth temperatures during the ALD process with respect to the two precursors. ( c ) X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy spectra of Pt /uniFB01 lms grown by ALD with the HDMP precursor at the temperatures of 100 and 300 °C. ( d ) SEM image of the surface of a pristine hair strand. ( e -f ) SEM images of a Pt-coated hair strand ( e ) after ALD at low temperatures and a corresponding higher-magni /uniFB01 cation image ( f ) (inset shows a far higher-magni /uniFB01 cation SEM image of f ). ( g ) SEM image showing the complex 3D surface of pristine paper. ( h -i ) SEM images of the surface of Pt-coated paper ( h ) and corresponding higher-magni /uniFB01 cation images ( i ).

Figure 3 ( a ) Plain-view /uniFB01 eld emission scanning electron microscope image of the complex 3D structures of the pristine cotton /uniFB01 ber. ( b -c ) SEM images showing the surface of Pt-coated cotton /uniFB01 ber obtained by ALD at low temperatures ( b ) and a corresponding higher-magni /uniFB01 cation SEM image ( c ). The inset in ( c ) shows a far higher-magni /uniFB01 cation SEM image. ( d ) Photograph of the pristine cotton /uniFB01 ber and Pt-coated cotton /uniFB01 ber obtained by ALD. ( e ) Electrical resistance change of the Pt-coated conductive cotton /uniFB01 ber with respect to the number of ALD cycles. ( f ) Change in the relative electrical resistance of the conductive cotton /uniFB01 ber during the 1000-cycle bending test.
